mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS player_id, p.name AS player_name, e.team_id AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(*) AS goals FROM fixture_event e JOIN fixture f ON f.id = e.fixture_id JOIN player p ON p.id = e.player_id JOIN team t ON t.id = e.team_id WHERE f.season_id = #{seasonId} AND f.status = 'FINISHED' AND e.event_type = 'GOAL' GROUP BY p.id, p.name, e.team_id, t.name ORDER BY goals DESC, p.name ASC

SELECT p.id AS player_id, p.name AS player_name, e.team_id AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(*) AS assists FROM fixture_event e JOIN fixture f ON f.id = e.fixture_id JOIN player p ON p.id = e.related_player_id JOIN team t ON t.id = e.team_id WHERE f.season_id = #{seasonId} AND f.status = 'FINISHED' AND e.event_type = 'GOAL' AND e.related_player_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.name, e.team_id, t.name ORDER BY assists DESC, p.name ASC

SELECT p.id AS player_id, p.name AS player_name, a.team_id AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a.fixture_id) AS appearances FROM fixture_appearance a JOIN fixture f ON f.id = a.fixture_id JOIN player p ON p.id = a.player_id JOIN team t ON t.id = a.team_id WHERE f.season_id = #{seasonId} AND f.status = 'FINISHED' GROUP BY p.id, p.name, a.team_id, t.name ORDER BY appearances DESC, p.name ASC

WITH results AS ( SELECT home_team_id AS team_id, home_score AS goals_for, away_score AS goals_against, CASE WHEN home_score > away_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS won, CASE WHEN home_score = away_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS drawn, CASE WHEN home_score < away_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lost FROM fixture WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND status = 'FINISHED' AND home_score IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT away_team_id AS team_id, away_score AS goals_for, home_score AS goals_against, CASE WHEN away_score > home_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS won, CASE WHEN away_score = home_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS drawn, CASE WHEN away_score < home_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lost FROM fixture WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND status = 'FINISHED' AND home_score IS NOT NULL ) SELECT st.team_id AS team_id, t.name AS team_name, COUNT(r.team_id) AS played, COALESCE(SUM(r.won), 0) AS won, COALESCE(SUM(r.drawn), 0) AS drawn, COALESCE(SUM(r.lost), 0) AS lost, COALESCE(SUM(r.goals_for), 0) AS goals_for, COALESCE(SUM(r.goals_against), 0) AS goals_against, COALESCE(SUM(r.goals_for), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(r.goals_against), 0) AS goal_difference, COALESCE(SUM(r.won), 0) * 3 + COALESCE(SUM(r.drawn), 0) AS points FROM season_team st JOIN team t ON t.id = st.team_id LEFT JOIN results r ON r.team_id = st.team_id WHERE st.season_id = #{seasonId} GROUP BY st.team_id, t.name ORDER BY points DESC, goal_difference DESC, goals_for DESC, won DESC, team_name ASC
